result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For a small company, I'd shortlist **Employment Hero, BambooHR, and Rippling**\. However, if your business is based in Australia, my first platform to investigate would be **Employment Hero** because it's designed for the Australian employment environment.

The best choice depends on whether you need basic HR administration or a complete HR, payroll and workforce management system.

## My top 5 HR software recommendations

![Employment Hero Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) - Brandfetch](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Z6qVhSSYF5CYFaR38tVZ9vpu364SrI1qcU-LhtFo5MrKvM2IIECP5NGDLvCA9qSi3OHN3nIGoWj3sOAoSGJ3TbpMzqye4Jq3Q2-1Ae4X05g3VDo154uJn7RkzUUAY3Xfi51rzm16rZPnUZ2NnrKj1KHaQU4ePGT94fhowd8mNNeyff58VJ3Le5GJh2e89NE4?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Employment Hero**

(Best for Australian small businesses)

- Employee records and onboarding
- Leave and attendance management
- Payroll and rostering options
- Employment documentation and compliance tools

Best if you want HR and employment administration in one ecosystem.

[Official website](https://employmenthero.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best overall HR management)

- Employee database
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Performance management
- Leave management and reporting

Great for companies wanting a polished, easy-to-use HR system. Check Australian payroll integration requirements.

[Official website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation)

- HR and payroll capabilities
- Employee onboarding automation
- IT and software access management
- Workflow automation

Particularly good for growing businesses with more complex systems.

[Official website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Perk's Integrations & Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-36AeKZsp77HjI6gk6yvjlFAxeLURLe6OMvfuoes9AFZsJ3kZKsPrncwZEFmhQDlwKSNmNoZSxO_o1GwtRaVu96-k75FVIBNkZQMWGxcjXsbG0TA8epUBxSazrJzfLFg9U5eICpqz6w-qXLzM1tseVa4UVAeYDhZ76KecbmYda1239fVKbrQV4sF82JletKr?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. HiBob**

(Best for employee engagement)

- Performance reviews
- Employee engagement
- People analytics
- Onboarding and employee experience

Good for companies investing in culture and people development.

[Official website](https://www.hibob.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee records
- Leave management
- Attendance tracking
- Performance management

Good for smaller teams wanting essential HR functionality without a large software budget.

[Official website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

These recommendations reflect 2026 software comparisons and feature assessments. | Automation and scalability | Rippling |

| Affordability | Zoho People |
